Sananga for Congested Nose and Dry Eyes
I use sananga drops for my medicine. My eyes get dry, and worst of all, it is to do with pressure in my eyes with pinching. That makes me wince my eyes closed quite uncontrollably, though if I were to take my sananga right when I feel the feelings, I get therapy. All the above symptoms go away right away after an application of my drops for some hours. It feels really relaxing and mind clearing. I forget what I was thinking when I take them. I focus on the stinging, of course. Though I always find my anxiety clears, anger, or whatever negative emotions due to applications of the drops. It is something chemical taking place in my cranium. Every time, my whole body goes limp and loose instead of tense and stressful. I always thought of this feeling as something related to euphoria. I feel blissful in my emotional state, though it literally feels like heaven.
It's uncomfortable with my breathing trouble when laying down on the bed. I found that sananga will help my breathing to be less slow on the inhale, and that gives me comfort when I sleep. I get deeper breathe. Sananga makes the nose drip, and it opens up the nostrils, whereas mine felt so closed up that I couldn't take an inhale through my nostrils. Mysteriously, my congestion has disappeared while using sananga drops. The dryness in my eyes is the same. Though as long as I regularly apply them, I saw the pinching and pressure loosens, and I get a break from the aggravation.
I'm worried about blindness. I'm worried about the possibilities of what could happen with no medicine. It's a real pain to deal with, and my eyes can get painful and irritated.
